desc: Erin in front of the reception desk in the office doing jumping jacks.
Erin, carrying a giant teddy bear, meets Darryl while walking up the stairs in the stairwell.
A shot of Creed at his desk, holding a colorful kite up to a fan in the office.
Pam, in a brown coat, carrying a folded blanket under her arm, walks through the warehouse carrying a blanket, then stops and scre ams in shock.
A close-up of the forest-and-logging mural, defaced with orange spray-painted graffiti reading "THIS SUCKS" and a crude drawing.
A shot of Angela talking angrily on the phone on the staircase.
Jim stands in a messy kitchen in his pajamas, eating breakfast at the counter, as Darryl walks in wearing a suit.
Darryl stands in a small bedroom, arms spread wide, showing off his room with a plaid bed and blinds behind him.
Jim jumps onto the bed in his pajamas, arms spread wide.
Jim lies on the bed with one hand behind his head, next to a pile of clothes on the floor by the bed.
Darryl's hand gestures toward one side of the bathroom counter, clean and organized, and the other side, messy and cluttered.
Darryl looks unimpressed, while Jim, reflected in the mirror, stands on the bed wrapped in a blanket, playing guitar.
Jim washes his hands in a dirty sink, wipes his hands with a towel, and throws it onto the sink.
Darryl walks into the bathroom and flips the light switch.
Pam rides up on a forklift in the warehouse, holding a megaphone.
Pam rides down on a forklift in the warehouse, speaking through a megaphone.
A shot of a silver metallic coffee thermos sitting on a desk, with a sticker reading "Darryl" on it.
Jim, sitting at his desk by the computer, drinks from a silver metallic coffee thermos.
Pam, in a grey hoodie, storms into the office yelling, as Erin at the reception desk looks at her.
An angry Dwight approaches the young man in glasses' desk from behind and takes his landline phone out of his hand.
Angela, in a black dress, runs up to Dwight in the office and touches his chest, and he flinches, stepping back.
Dwight hands out white papers to the workers in uniforms, sitting at a long table in the warehouse.
A redheaded woman stands with her hands on her hips, draws a circle in the air with her fingers.
A man in a warehouse worker uniform crouches with his head buried in his hand beside some boxes.
Pam, in a grey hoodie, stands next to Dwight in the warehouse, pressing her hands to the sides of her face and ears, stressed.
Oscar and Kevin, eating a snack from small plates, stand in a living room of some house, glancing at a portrait of an angry-looking, posing Angela.
Jim pours out coffee onto the floor, standing next to a red wall.
Jim forcefully shoves the thermal silver mug into Darryl's chest as he walks past him, handing it to him.
A man standing behind Oscar, hands on his shoulders, pats his cheek in front of everyone at a gathering.
Darryl sits down in a leather armchair white and blue portable cooler  in the room.
Darryl takes a green can out of a cooler, while Jim eats at a table nearby in the room.
Dwight leads a young man in a warehouse uniform by the arm down the street, with Pam walking beside them.
Pam puts a cap on the young man in glasses' head and shushes him, pressing her finger to his lips.
Dwight peeks through binoculars, as Pam ends the call and exits through a door behind the boxes.
A young man in glasses, taped to a chair with something written on his chest, looks down at his phone.
A man pushes a woman in a wheelchair toward the spot where everyone is posing for a photo.
Pam, holding a bucket and paintbrush, walks around a car covered in white paint as Dwight keeps painting it.
Dwight, with a shocked and admiring expression, walks around the car and admires the large painting on its side.
A satisfied Pam stands by the open trunk as an angry warehouse worker storms toward her across the parking lot.
A camera operator with headphones swings a long boom microphone and hits an angry warehouse worker in the office parking lot.
